scenario: 200 turns, 1000 tool calls, 20 live replies; one browser worker; three runs per project before and after, then two desktop control runs with RAYNO_REACT_COMPILER=0
limitations: Browser emulation on a Mac, without CPU throttling. No physical iPhone.
shownAfter includes fixture encryption, socket delivery, React work, and layout; it does not isolate React render time.
Variants ran in sequence. Timing variance and the later control runs prevent a reliable speedup claim.
